suggestions.guidance_rule: An employee's salary may be updated only by HR or by that employee's direct manager.
suggestions.missing_context: No 'update_employee' (or similar salary-update) tool is in tool_definitions.json under the current session scope, so there is no update call to attach this rule to. Even if it were in scope, system_vars.json has no manager/direct-report relationship field (e.g. a 'manager_id' or 'direct_reports' claim for the subject) needed to check 'direct manager'.
suggestions.reason: This rule cannot be enforced without both an in-scope update tool and a system variable describing the subject's direct reports.

suggestions.guidance_rule: Only HR may add or update a department, add or delete a country holiday, or set a leave allotment.
suggestions.missing_context: Tools 'update_department', 'add_holiday', 'delete_holiday', and 'set_leave_allotment' are not present in tool_definitions.json under the current session scope (only 'add_employee' and 'add_department' are selected), so these parts of the rule cannot be enforced. The 'add_department' portion is enforced in the generated policy.
suggestions.reason: These tools exist in the agent's action_list but were excluded from tool_definitions.json by the current session_config.json tool selection. Re-run get_mcp_parameter with these tools selected to enforce the HR-only restriction for them.

suggestions.guidance_rule: department — one of Corporate Leadership, Engineering, Product, HR, Finance.
suggestions.missing_context: add_employee only accepts 'department_id', an opaque integer foreign key, not the department name string. The enum check cannot be applied there without a lookup from department_id to department name, which is not available in tool arguments or system variables.
suggestions.reason: Cannot validate department_id against a name enum without a department_id -> name mapping, which is not in system_vars.json or tool_definitions.json. The enum check is enforced on add_department.name instead, where the value is a plain string.

note: These are suggestions for future tool-scope or system-variable additions. They are NOT part of the current policy.
